messages.subject: producing NaN when calculating occupancy
parts:
I am running an analysis of camera trapping in the amazon trying to understand the influence of distance to saltlicks in the precense of tapirs and get this error:

Call:
occu(formula = ~1 ~ Distance, data = UFO1)

Occupancy:
             Estimate  SE   z P(>|z|)
(Intercept) -0.461047 NaN NaN     NaN
Distance     0.000875 NaN NaN     NaN

Detection:
 Estimate    SE     z  P(>|z|)
    -2.33 0.193 -12.1 1.76e-33

AIC: 301.0213
Warning message:
In sqrt(diag(vcov(obj))) : NaNs produced

does it mean that the covariable (distance to the nearest saltlick) is having an influence in tapir´s occupancy?

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] producing NaN when calculating occupancy
parts:
Dear JAC-AB,

not really ... This is a numerical error which really precludes inference for now.

Have you tried the Null model before, with an intercept for both model parts ? Does this also yield NaNs ? What is your sample size: number of sites, number of replicate surveys ?

Best regards ---  MMMK
